device.description: Default device to operate on when no device argument is provided.

scheme.description: Partitioning scheme to use (must be one of the documented valid schemes).

devices.description: List of devices to list or query sizes for when using batch mode (e.g., /dev/sda, mbrdump.bin).

list_mode.description: Enable non-interactive listing of partition tables for specified devices.

size_mode.description: Enable non-interactive size display for specified partitions.
